name: Company internal DNS-over-HTTPS resolver
tier_rationale: Company-operated resolver configured by the team (setting doh_internal, https only); the opsec option for typosquat permutation lists and the only resolver allowed under TLP:RED (A2, P029 cond 5 and 7).

reliability.justification: The organisation's own resolver: answers as served by the company DNS infrastructure.

resolver.title: DNS answers from the company internal DoH resolver

terms.quote: The resolver list is configurable (setting doh_providers, https only, validated) and may include the company's internal DoH, listed first when set.

resolver.notes: Quote: binding council text (P029 cond 5). Company-operated: no third-party terms apply. provider_id of the 'internal' resolver of core/dns.py.
